description: Assess the risk of hidden-city ticketing: buying a ticket to a farther airport and getting off at the layover. Returns the saving, a verdict, deal-breakers, risks and the airline's policy.

bag.description: True if you would check a bag

beyond.description: Final airport on the cheaper ticket, e.g. DUB, EDI, MAN, BRU, AMS for LHR

direct.description: Price of the normal ticket to your real destination, USD

from.description: Origin airport IATA code, e.g. JFK

loyalty.description: True if a frequent flyer number is on the booking

round_trip.description: True if the ticket is a return

throwaway.description: Price of the cheaper ticket to the airport beyond, USD

to.description: Hub airport where you would actually get off, e.g. LHR

name: check_hidden_city_ticket
title: Check a hidden-city ticket
